title: syncthing folder data
description: Shape of .chezmoidata/syncthing.yaml. Merged into the same template data as hosts.yaml. Validates structure only -- it cannot catch a path that is a symlink on one host, a folder no host sources, or an id that disagrees between hosts.

syncthing.description: Syncthing folders shared between every host with the `emulation` role. A fourth flat list alongside quadlets/units/endpoints, with the same drift property: nothing errors when it disagrees with reality.

folders.description: One entry per synced folder. Paths must point at REAL storage on every emulation host -- ~/Emulation/saves/ is a farm of absolute symlinks EmuDeck regenerates per host, so syncing it replicates broken links and no data.

id.description: Syncthing folder ID. Must be identical on every host sharing the folder.

path.description: Home-relative path, no leading / or ~. Rendered as %h/<path>.

oneOf.description: Send Only on `source`, Receive Only elsewhere. Requires `source`.
Send & Receive everywhere, with simple file versioning (keep 5).

source.description: Authoritative host for a oneway folder. Must name a host in `hosts`.
